channel.title: Al-Jazeera Media Network - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Al-Jazeera Media Network (aljazeera.com)

item.title: Anger on Pakistan streets, 20 dead, after US-Israel strike kills Khamenei
item.description: At least 20 people killed across Pakistan as demonstrations over strike on Tehran spiral into violence.

item.title: Iraqi police disperse pro-Iran protesters near US embassy
item.description: Iraqi riot police fired warning shots and tear gas to disperse pro-Iran protesters near the US embassy in Baghdad.

item.title: Tehran comes under attack from new round of Israeli strikes
item.description: Videos show heavy bombardment of Tehran after Israel’s military said it had launched another wave of attacks on Iran.

item.title: Poll suggests only a quarter of Americans support attacks on Iran
item.description: US lawmakers heap pressure on Trump following the first US soldier deaths after Khamenei's killing.

item.title: Netanyahu vows increasing strikes on Tehran
item.description: Israel’s prime minister says strikes on Tehran will increase in the coming days, with US support.

item.title: Israel bombs Beirut after Hezbollah fires rockets in Iran war retaliation
item.description: Israel has carried out heavy strikes in the southern suburbs of Lebanon’s capital Beirut.

item.title: Balen Shah: Rapper, mayor, Nepal’s next prime minister?
item.description: His sunglasses and songs are the rage, but the ex-Kathmandu mayor has his sights on Nepal's top job.

item.title: Al Jazeera reports from Beirut as residents flee following Israeli strikes
item.description: Tens of thousands of Lebanese civilians are leaving areas in Beirut following Israeli strikes and forced displacement.

item.title: After Iran’s salvo hit their skylines, will Gulf states enter the war?
item.description: Gulf states face an impossible choice after Iranian attacks: remain passive, or risk being seen as fighting with Israel.

item.title: Analysis: Khamenei’s killing leaves Iran’s ‘axis’ in disarray
item.description: While Tehran warns it will ‘burn everything’, its proxies face a choice between suicidal revenge and local survival.
